title: WPSS/785/2009 of GHANENDRA KUMAR ATTRI Vs UNION OF INDIA and OTHERS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition (S/S) No. 785 of 2009
Ghanendra Kumar Attri ÖÖ Petitioner
Vs
Union of India & others Ö.Ö Respondents
Mr. P.S.Bohra, Advocate present for the petitioner.
None, present for the respondent.
Honíble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J. (Oral)
1. The petitioner was appointed as a constable in
Sashatra Seema Bal (hereinafter referred to as ìSSBî), which
is Paramilitary Force of the Government of India. At the time
of recruitment, the petitioner stated as ìNoî to the following
questions which was put to him, read as under:-
ìa) Have you ever been arrested, prosecuted, kept
under detention or bound down/fined, convicted by a
court of law for any offence, debarred-disqualified by
any public Service Commission from appearing at its
examination/selections, or debarred from taking any
explanation-rusticated by any University or any other
educational authority-Institution.
b) Is any case pending against you in any court of
law, University or any other educational authority-institution at the time of filling up this Verification Roll?
If the answer to (a) or (b) is ëyesí full particulars of
the case, arrest, detention fine, conviction, sentence,
etc., and the nature of the case pending in the court-University-educational authority, etc., at the time of
filling up this form should be given.î

2. Moreover in the same application the petitioner
has also given the following undertaking:-
 ìUNDERTAKING
I do hereby undertake that all
documents/information submitted by me to the
Commandant, 3rd Battalion, SSB, Almora (UA) in
connection with my recruitment are true to the best of
my knowledge. In case found false and also during
verification of my character and antecedents by the

2
Police authority, if and adverse remarks, I will liable to
be terminated from my serviceî
3. The petitioner admitted the signature in the above
ìundertakingî. The services of the petitioner, however,
terminated on 16.12.2008. The grounds given for
terminating the services of the petitioner by the authority
concerned that the petitioner suppressed the material fact
and gave a wrong undertaking on 05.06.2006. The
undertaking (referred above) is the part of the record.
4. The fact that the petitioner, while joined the
services, gave an undertaking that there was no police case
pending against him whereas the fact is that a First
Information Report was lodged against him under Sections
147, 208, 323 and 452 of I.P.C. in which the petitioner faced
trial though in the trial he was ultimately acquitted on
08.07.2012. This is, however, not material. What is material
in the present case is that at the time of his recruitment, the
petitioner gave false undertaking that he was never arrested
nor any criminal case is pending against him.
5. In view thereof, there is no ground to interfere in
the impugned order. The ground of the petitioner that he was
not aware that such undertaking was ever given by him on
05.06.2006, however, he admits his signature on the same.
The second ground that at the time of crime, he was juvenile
i.e. he was less than 18 years of age, and therefore, he would
have no knowledge of the criminal case, is not acceptable, as
at the time when the petitioner gave such undertaking
(referred above) he was a major and gave a false affidavit to
the authority concerned.

3
6. In view of the aforesaid observations, the writ
petition being devoid of merit is dismissed. No order as to
costs.
 (Sudhanshu Dhulia,J.)
23.05.2014
Nitesh
